release_notes: Added RTX 50-series and Blackwell runtime compatibility improvements.
Added cleaner CUDA, cuDNN, and TensorRT repair for newer NVIDIA GPUs.
Added real cuDNN compatibility testing before NVIDIA startup.
Added automatic DirectML and CPU fallback if the NVIDIA path is unavailable.
Added new Hipfire tracking mode with Never, R1, and R2 activation options.
Hipfire operates separately from the normal Aim Gate.
Removed Step 1 and Step 2 from the in-app video guides.
Setup tutorial links are now included in the VIDEO TUTORIAL READ ME file.
Fixed update handoff and relaunch loop.
Improved post-update version verification and restart behavior.
Includes previous updater SSL, DirectML/CPU, Window Capture, and stability fixes.
